day.headline: A Ox day — Snake and Rooster are in step.

reasons: Ox's own day — your energy runs high
signs.message: Send the draft before you reread it a fifth time.

reasons: Snake and Ox share a triad — strong alignment today
signs.message: Book the retake today. That photo's been slandering you for years.

reasons: Dog sits apart from Ox — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: It's shut by four. Make it your first stop today.

reasons: Monkey sits apart from Ox — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Held together by nothing and thriving. Push it further today.

reasons: Rooster and Ox share a triad — strong alignment today
signs.message: You started accepting worse. Put the bar back where it was.

reasons: Rat pairs with Ox — a harmonious day
signs.message: The basil's going again. Use what's left in tonight's dinner.

reasons: Horse sits apart from Ox — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: the quiet hour before anyone arrives
signs.message: Nobody's in yet. Do the one task you keep dodging.

reasons: Pig sits apart from Ox — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Make the ugly first pass today. It's supposed to be ugly.

reasons: Rabbit sits apart from Ox — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: a heat that slows the day
signs.message: Eighty-eight degrees in November. Move slowly, stay where the shade is.

reasons: Dragon sits apart from Ox — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: a mood that arrived without warning
signs.message: It showed up uninvited. No need to explain it to anyone.

reasons: Tiger sits apart from Ox — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Third pass and it still won't stick. Shut the book.

reasons: Goat opposes Ox — a day to take slowly
signs.message: Pick the window, stare at nothing, let the afternoon go.
